picks.why: nVent grows revenue 44% with an 18% operating margin and positive free cash flow at 15.5x forward earnings, yet trades 41% off its high and 25% below its 200-day. It is a direct play on the power-is-the-binding-constraint thesis in the steadiest overweight segment, where Powell's record backlog confirms demand.
picks.risk: If the rotation back into chips persists and data-centre siting slows, electrical enclosure and liquid-cooling orders could stall and the multiple compress further.

picks.risk: Free cash flow is thin at a 1% yield and customer concentration is high, so one hyperscaler cutting active-cable orders would break the growth story.
